description: This file contains functions and classes for verifying and handling JWT tokens issued by Supabase, including fetching JWKS, caching, and integrating with FastAPI dependencies for authentication.

methods.name: get_supabase_url
methods.description: Returns the SUPABASE_URL environment variable or raises an error if missing.

methods.name: _jwks_url
methods.description: Constructs the JWKS URL based on the SUPABASE_URL.

methods.name: _get_cached_jwks
methods.description: Retrieves cached JWKS data if valid, otherwise None.

methods.name: _set_cached_jwks
methods.description: Caches JWKS data with a TTL.

methods.name: _fetch_jwks
methods.description: Fetches JWKS from Supabase and caches it.

methods.name: _get_kid
methods.description: Extracts the 'kid' from a JWT header without verification.

methods.name: _find_jwk_for_kid
methods.description: Finds the JWK matching the given 'kid' in the JWKS.

methods.name: _expected_issuers
methods.description: Returns the list of valid issuer URLs for Supabase tokens.

methods.name: verify_jwt
methods.description: Verifies a JWT token's signature and claims, returning the decoded claims if valid.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that extracts and verifies the JWT from the Authorization header, returning user claims.
